explorer.title: See where your plumbing goes wrong.
explorer.intro: Water is moving through the pipes in your walls right now. Tap a marker to see what goes wrong there, and the signs you can spot yourself.
explorer.alt: A drawing of a house cut open, with its water pipes, water heater and drains
explorer.go: Not sure? Ask us to take a look

spots.label: Water heater
spots.what: Sediment settles at the bottom of the tank and the parts inside wear out. Most tank heaters last 8 to 12 years.
signs: Rumbling or popping when it heats

spots.label: Kitchen sink
spots.what: Grease and food scraps build up in the drain, and the faucet's seals wear out a little with every use.
signs: Water draining slowly or backing up
A faucet that drips when it's off
Damp or swollen wood in the cabinet below

spots.label: Toilet
spots.what: A worn flapper or fill valve lets water run all day, and a failing wax seal leaks under the floor where you can't see it.
signs: It runs or refills on its own
It rocks when you sit on it

spots.label: Shower & tub
spots.what: Hair and soap narrow the drain, and old valves start to leak inside the wall long before it shows.
signs: Hot water that comes and goes
Stains on the ceiling below the bathroom

spots.label: Main shut-off
spots.what: The valve that turns off the water to the whole house. When a pipe bursts, finding it fast saves the floors.
signs: You don't know where it is
It's stiff, rusted or won't close all the way

spots.label: Sewer line
spots.what: The main line carries everything out to the street. Tree roots, grease and sagging pipe block it.
signs: Several drains slow at the same time
The toilet gurgles when the sink drains
A sewage smell or soggy patches in the yard

faq.q: A pipe just burst. What do I do first?
faq.a: Turn off the main shut-off valve, switch off the water heater, and call us. Move anything valuable away from the water while you wait.

faq.q: How long does a water heater last?
faq.a: A tank heater usually lasts 8 to 12 years, and a tankless one longer. Hard water and skipped flushes shorten that.

faq.q: Should I use drain cleaner from the store?
faq.a: It can clear a light clog, but it's harsh on older pipes and often just moves the blockage further down. If a drain keeps going slow, it's worth clearing properly.

faq.q: Why has my water bill gone up?
faq.a: A running toilet or a hidden leak is the usual reason. Turn every tap off and look at the water meter: if it's still moving, water is going somewhere.

faq.q: Do you tell me the price before you start?
faq.a: Yes. Once we've seen the problem we tell you what it will cost, and the work only starts when you agree.

faq.q: How do I know if it's my sewer line?
faq.a: If several drains back up at once, or the toilet gurgles when the sink drains, the main line is the usual suspect.

title: What's happening
at your place?
helper.intro: Pick the closest one. Here's what to do in the next five minutes, before we get there.

items.label: Water's leaking
steps: Turn off the small valve under the sink or behind the toilet. If you can't find one, or the water won't stop, close the main shut-off.
Keep away from water near outlets, cords or the electrical panel. Don't touch switches with wet hands.
Move what you can off the floor and soak up the water with towels.
items.note: Most main shut-offs are where the water line comes in: by the water heater, in the garage, or in a box near the street.

items.label: No hot water
steps: Electric heater: check the breaker marked for it in your panel.
Gas heater: check whether the pilot light is out. Relight it only if the instructions on the tank say how.
Water around the base of the tank? Close the cold water valve on top of it.
items.note: Smell gas? Don't touch any switches. Leave the house and call your gas company's emergency line from outside.

items.label: Drain backing up
steps: Stop running water anywhere in the house, including the washer and the dishwasher.
One slow drain: try a plunger. Skip chemical drain cleaners, which can splash and harm older pipes.
Several drains slow at once, or water coming up in a tub or shower? That points to the main sewer line. Call us.
items.note: Keep children and pets away from backed-up water. It can carry sewage.

items.label: Toilet won't stop
steps: Turn the valve behind the toilet clockwise until it stops. That shuts off the water to the tank.
Overflowing? Lift the tank lid and pull the float up to stop the fill.
Don't flush again until it's fixed.
items.note: A leaking toilet can waste about 200 gallons a day, says the EPA, often without a sound.

title: What's that drip
really costing?
drip_calc.intro: Count the drops for a minute, then slide to the number.
drip_calc.label: Drips a minute
drip_calc.source: Based on the EPA's WaterSense figures: a tap dripping once a second wastes over 3,000 gallons a year, and an average shower uses about 17 gallons.
